<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Included since Arcantry 0.3.0</span><code>$select-task-skills</code></p>

Choose up to three installed or project-installable Codex skills for a complex, multi-domain, or unfamiliar task. Use implicitly before such tasks or explicitly when the user asks which skills apply; do not use for simple single-domain work or install anything.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link select-task-skills
```

## Examples

### Route a multi-domain task

**Prompt**

> Use $select-task-skills for this repository task and choose no more than three skills that materially improve it.

**Expected outcome**

A short use-now or install-first selection based on actual triggers, with overlapping candidates omitted.

### Discover project-local skills

**Prompt**

> Use $select-task-skills to check whether this project declares a skill for the unfamiliar workflow I requested.

**Expected outcome**

A catalog-backed recommendation that does not install, enable, update, or remove any skill.
